title: 种子去旅行
subtitle: 它们不会走路，可是哪儿都去过
character: wearing a mustard yellow t-shirt and brown corduroy overalls, red sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, cut paper collage, textured handmade paper, warm earth tones with fresh green, layered flat shapes, soft daylight

pages.zh:
大树站在那里，
一辈子都不动。
pages.scene: A single very large old tree standing alone in a wide open field, deep roots, completely still, soft daylight, plenty of empty space around it, cut paper collage style.

pages.zh:
可是它的小树，
长到了很远很远的地方。
它们是怎么去的呢？
pages.scene: The same wide field with several small young trees growing far away from the big old tree, showing the long distance between them, layered paper shapes.

pages.zh:
蒲公英的「种子」
有一把小伞。
风一吹——
呼，飞走了。
pages.scene: A dandelion seed head with several seeds lifting off in the wind, each seed carrying a small white parachute, floating across a pale sky, cut paper collage.

pages.zh:
枫树的种子
有两片翅膀。
掉下来的时候，
转啊转，
像小螺旋桨。
pages.scene: Two winged maple seeds spinning down through the air like little propellers, motion shown with soft curved paper lines, warm autumn colours.

pages.zh:
苍耳的种子
全身都是小钩子。
它钩住小狗的毛，
搭了一段顺风车。
pages.scene: Close up of a dog's furry leg with several small hooked burr seeds stuck in the hair, the dog walking through tall grass, collage textures.

pages.zh:
还有的种子藏在果子里。
小鸟把果子吃掉，
飞到很远的地方，
种子就跟着搬了家。
pages.scene: A small bird holding a red berry in its beak on a branch, and further away in the distance the same bird flying over a wide field, layered paper landscape.

pages.zh:
椰子最厉害。
它掉进海里，
漂啊漂，漂过一整片大海，
在另一个岛上发芽。
pages.scene: A coconut floating on the surface of a calm sea, drifting along, a small green island in the distance, flat collage waves.

pages.zh:
有的种子会自己弹。
果荚晒干了，
啪的一声裂开，
把种子弹得远远的。
pages.scene: A dry seed pod splitting open with a snap, small seeds flying outward in several directions, short motion lines, warm paper textures.

pages.zh:
种子不会走路。
可是风会带它，
水会送它，
小鸟和小狗
会捎上它。
pages.scene: One small seed at the centre of the picture with the wind, a stream of water, a bird and a dog arranged gently around it in a ring, all helping it travel, symmetrical collage composition.

pages.zh:
我口袋里有一颗种子，
是刚才在路上捡的。
我把它种在院子里。
这一次——
是我帮它。
pages.scene: A little boy crouching in a garden pressing a single seed into the soil with one finger, a small watering can beside him, warm afternoon light, cut paper collage.
